trigger_observation.rule: baseline has a cost line and max ceil(line.total_cost_cents * 10000 / line.notional_cents) >= 50
trigger_observation.threshold_selection_provenance: Post-hoc exploratory R01 design choice. Every integer threshold from 24 through 62 selects the same five observed cases; 50 is a round interior value and requires new-frame validation without retuning.

candidate_headroom_diagnostic.definition: max true utility among generated candidates minus BASELINE true utility, computed only after trigger and candidate bytes are fixed
candidate_headroom_diagnostic.warning: This is an oracle selector upper bound on five exploratory R01 cases, not an expected LLM effect.

rejected_trigger_candidate.rule: total baseline cost >= 7 bps OR baseline max cap utilization >= 6500 bps
rejected_trigger_candidate.reason_rejected: The broader trigger produced nine baseline-optimal opportunities and mixed concentration cases with no matching frozen transform.

sample_size_recommendation.challenge_assumption: All admitted challenge fixtures are trigger true, K >= 2, and candidate-headroom positive by frozen frame rule.
sample_size_recommendation.power_model: Trigger indicator is Bernoulli; nontrigger and failed-selector deltas are zero; triggered successful deltas have unit variance and stated standardized mean; one-sided normal lower-bound approximation at alpha 0.05.
blocking_before_statistical_freeze: stratified bootstrap simulation matching the final estimator
new-frame trigger-rate verification without threshold changes
